WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id, platform FROM distributions WHERE status = 'published' AND published_at >= $1 AND published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = distributions.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ) SELECT c.platform, COALESCE(SUM(latest.views), 0) AS views, COALESCE(SUM(latest.likes), 0) AS likes, COALESCE(SUM(latest.comments), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(latest.shares), 0) AS shares, COALESCE(SUM(latest.watch_time_sec), 0) AS watch_time_sec, COALESCE(SUM(latest.reach), 0) AS reach, COALESCE(SUM(latest.impressions), 0) AS impressions, COUNT(*) AS post_count, MAX(latest.snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.watch_time_sec, s.reach, s.impressions, s.snapshot_at FROM analytics_snapshots s WHERE s.distribution_id = c.id AND s.snapshot_at <= $2 ORDER BY s.snapshot_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true GROUP BY c.platform ORDER BY c.platform ASC

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT d.id, d.platform, d.published_at, CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = d.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END AS format FROM distributions d WHERE d.status = 'published' AND d.published_at >= $1 AND d.published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR d.platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR d.brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR d.platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = d.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = d.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL )), baseline AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.distribution_id) s.distribution_id, s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.impressions, s.reach, s.snapshot_at, s.id, 1 AS is_baseline FROM analytics_snapshots s JOIN candidates c ON c.id = s.distribution_id WHERE s.snapshot_at < $1 ORDER BY s.distribution_id, s.snapshot_at DESC, s.id DESC ), events AS ( SELECT s.distribution_id, s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.impressions, s.reach, s.snapshot_at, s.id, 0 AS is_baseline FROM analytics_snapshots s JOIN candidates c ON c.id = s.distribution_id WHERE s.snapshot_at >= $1 AND s.snapshot_at <= $2 UNION ALL SELECT distribution_id, views, likes, comments, shares, impressions, reach, snapshot_at, id, is_baseline FROM baseline ), deltas AS ( SELECT e.distribution_id, c.platform, e.snapshot_at, e.is_baseline, CASE WHEN e.is_baseline = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(e.views - COALESCE(lag(e.views) OVER w, 0), 0) END AS views, CASE WHEN e.is_baseline = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(e.likes - COALESCE(lag(e.likes) OVER w, 0), 0) END AS likes, CASE WHEN e.is_baseline = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(e.comments - COALESCE(lag(e.comments) OVER w, 0), 0) END AS comments, CASE WHEN e.is_baseline = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(e.shares - COALESCE(lag(e.shares) OVER w, 0), 0) END AS shares, CASE WHEN e.is_baseline = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(e.impressions - COALESCE(lag(e.impressions) OVER w, 0), 0) END AS impressions, CASE WHEN e.is_baseline = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(e.reach - COALESCE(lag(e.reach) OVER w, 0), 0) END AS reach FROM events e JOIN candidates c ON c.id = e.distribution_id WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY e.distribution_id ORDER BY e.snapshot_at, e.id) ), snapshot_days AS ( SELECT date_trunc('day', snapshot_at)::date AS date, platform, SUM(views) AS views, SUM(likes) AS likes, SUM(comments) AS comments, SUM(shares) AS shares, SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(reach) AS reach, MAX(snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at FROM deltas GROUP BY 1, 2 ), published_days AS ( SELECT date_trunc('day', published_at)::date AS date, platform, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM candidates GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT date, platform, SUM(posts)::int AS posts, SUM(views) AS views, SUM(likes) AS likes, SUM(comments) AS comments, SUM(shares) AS shares, SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(reach) AS reach, MAX(last_synced_at) AS last_synced_at FROM ( SELECT date, platform, 0::bigint AS posts, views, likes, comments, shares, impressions, reach, last_synced_at FROM snapshot_days UNION ALL SELECT date, platform, posts, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL FROM published_days ) parts GROUP BY date, platform ORDER BY date ASC, platform ASC

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT d.id, d.platform, d.published_at, CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = d.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END AS format FROM distributions d WHERE d.status = 'published' AND d.published_at >= $1 AND d.published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR d.platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR d.brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR d.platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = d.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = d.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL )), latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.distribution_id) s.distribution_id, s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.impressions, s.reach, s.watch_time_sec, s.saves, s.clicks, s.snapshot_at FROM analytics_snapshots s JOIN candidates c ON c.id = s.distribution_id WHERE s.snapshot_at <= $2 ORDER BY s.distribution_id, s.snapshot_at DESC, s.id DESC ), joined AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.id, c.platform, c.published_at, c.format, l.views, l.likes, l.comments, l.shares, l.impressions, l.reach, l.watch_time_sec, l.saves, l.clicks, l.snapshot_at FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.distribution_id = c.id ) SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(platform_row) FROM ( SELECT c.platform, COUNT(*)::int AS posts, COALESCE(SUM(c.views), 0) AS views, COALESCE(SUM(c.likes), 0) AS likes, COALESCE(SUM(c.comments), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(c.shares), 0) AS shares, COALESCE(SUM(c.impressions), 0) AS impressions, COALESCE(SUM(c.reach), 0) AS reach, COALESCE(SUM(c.watch_time_sec), 0) AS watch_time_sec, SUM(c.saves) AS saves, SUM(c.clicks) AS clicks, CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(c.views, 0)) > 0 THEN (SUM(COALESCE(c.likes, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(c.comments, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(c.shares, 0)))::float8 / SUM(COALESCE(c.views, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS engagement_rate, MAX(c.snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at FROM joined c GROUP BY c.platform ORDER BY c.platform ASC ) AS platform_row ), '[]'::json) AS platforms, COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(format_row) FROM ( SELECT c.format, COUNT(*)::int AS posts, COALESCE(SUM(c.views), 0) AS views, COALESCE(SUM(c.likes), 0) AS likes, COALESCE(SUM(c.comments), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(c.shares), 0) AS shares, (SUM(COALESCE(c.likes, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(c.comments, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(c.shares, 0))) AS engagement, MAX(c.snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at FROM joined c GROUP BY c.format ORDER BY posts DESC, c.format ASC ) AS format_row ), '[]'::json) AS formats, COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(best_row) FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM c.published_at)::int AS day_of_week, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM c.published_at)::int AS hour, COUNT(*)::int AS posts, AVG(COALESCE(c.views, 0))::float8 AS avg_views, AVG(COALESCE(c.likes, 0))::float8 AS avg_likes, AVG(COALESCE(c.comments, 0))::float8 AS avg_comments, AVG(COALESCE(c.shares, 0))::float8 AS avg_shares, AVG(COALESCE(c.likes, 0) + COALESCE(c.comments, 0) + COALESCE(c.shares, 0))::float8 AS avg_engagement FROM joined c GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2 ASC ) AS best_row ), '[]'::json) AS best_times

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT d.id, d.platform, d.published_at, CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = d.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END AS format FROM distributions d WHERE d.status = 'published' AND d.published_at >= $1 AND d.published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR d.platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR d.brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR d.platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = d.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = d.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL )), snapshots AS ( SELECT c.id AS distribution_id, c.published_at, s.snapshot_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.snapshot_at - c.published_at)) / 3600 AS elapsed_hours, (s.likes + s.comments + s.shares) AS engagement FROM candidates c JOIN analytics_snapshots s ON s.distribution_id = c.id WHERE s.snapshot_at >= c.published_at AND s.snapshot_at <= $2 AND s.snapshot_at <= c.published_at + INTERVAL '720 hours' ), buckets(hours) AS (VALUES (1), (6), (24), (72), (168), (720)), per_bucket AS ( SELECT buckets.hours, snapshots.distribution_id, MAX(snapshots.engagement) AS engagement FROM buckets JOIN snapshots ON snapshots.elapsed_hours <= buckets.hours GROUP BY buckets.hours, snapshots.distribution_id ) SELECT hours::int AS elapsed_hours, AVG(engagement)::float8 AS avg_engagement, COUNT(*)::int AS observations FROM per_bucket GROUP BY hours ORDER BY hours ASC

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT d.id AS distribution_id, d.post_id, d.platform, d.published_at FROM distributions d WHERE d.status = 'published' AND d.published_at >= $1 AND d.published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR d.platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR d.brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR d.platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(d.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = d.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = d.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ), latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.distribution_id) s.distribution_id, s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.snapshot_at FROM analytics_snapshots s JOIN candidates c ON c.distribution_id = s.distribution_id WHERE s.snapshot_at <= $2 ORDER BY s.distribution_id, s.snapshot_at DESC, s.id DESC ), per_post AS ( SELECT c.post_id, MIN(c.published_at) AS published_at, COUNT(*) AS destination_count, COUNT(l.distribution_id) AS synced_destination_count, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT c.platform ORDER BY c.platform) AS platforms, MAX(l.snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at, COALESCE(SUM(l.views), 0) AS views, COALESCE(SUM(l.likes), 0) AS likes, COALESCE(SUM(l.comments), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(l.shares), 0) AS shares FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.distribution_id = c.distribution_id GROUP BY c.post_id ) SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title, LEFT(btrim(regexp_replace(p.default_text, '\s+', ' ', 'g')), 140) AS excerpt, pp.published_at, pp.destination_count, pp.synced_destination_count, pp.platforms, pp.last_synced_at, pp.views, pp.likes, pp.comments, pp.shares FROM per_post pp JOIN posts p ON p.id = pp.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pp.views DESC, pp.published_at DESC, pp.post_id ASC LIMIT $7 OFFSET $8

WITH baseline AS ( SELECT account.id AS account_id, account.platform, account.display_name AS account_name, latest.followers, latest.captured_at FROM platform_accounts account JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT snapshot.followers, snapshot.captured_at FROM platform_account_snapshots snapshot WHERE snapshot.platform_account_id = account.id AND snapshot.captured_at < $1 ORDER BY snapshot.captured_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true WHERE ($3::text IS NULL OR account.platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR account.brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR account.id = $5) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = account.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ), daily AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (account.id, date_trunc('day', snapshot.captured_at)) account.id AS account_id, account.platform, account.display_name AS account_name, snapshot.followers, snapshot.captured_at FROM platform_account_snapshots snapshot JOIN platform_accounts account ON account.id = snapshot.platform_account_id WHERE snapshot.captured_at >= $1 AND snapshot.captured_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR account.platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR account.brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR account.id = $5) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = account.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY account.id, date_trunc('day', snapshot.captured_at), snapshot.captured_at DESC ) SELECT * FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT * FROM daily ORDER BY platform ASC, account_id ASC, captured_at ASC

SELECT u.id, u.auth_user_id, u.email, u.display_name, u.installation_owner, u.suspended_at, o.id AS workspace_id, o.name AS workspace_name, o.slug AS workspace_slug, membership.role AS workspace_role FROM users u JOIN org_members membership ON membership.user_id = u.id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = membership.org_id AND o.is_shared WHERE u.auth_user_id = $1 AND u.email = $2 AND u.display_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3::text AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR o.id = $4) AND (NOT u.installation_owner OR membership.role = 'admin') LIMIT 1
UPDATE asset_objects SET write_hold_until = GREATEST(write_hold_until, $3::timestamptz), updated_at = now() WHERE asset_id = $1 AND kind = 'staging' AND r2_key = $2 AND status <> 'deleted'

SELECT u.email, u.name, u."emailVerified" AS email_verified, iu.suspended_at FROM "session" s JOIN "user" u ON u.id = s."userId" LEFT JOIN users iu ON iu.auth_user_id = u.id WHERE s.id = $1 AND u.id = $2 AND s."expiresAt" > now()

INSERT INTO flow_runs (environment, trace_id, request_id, org_id, entrypoint, status, metadata) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'running', $6) ON CONFLICT (environment, request_id) DO UPDATE SET entrypoint = EXCLUDED.entrypoint, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata WHERE flow_runs.org_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.org_id RETURNING id
UPDATE flow_runs SET status = $1, error_code = $2, retryable = $3, finished_at = now(), duration_ms = round(extract(epoch from (now() - started_at)) * 1000) WHERE id = $4
